candidates.title: Account Ownership and Saved Pet Verification Copy
candidates.change: Updates sign_in headline and body copy to clearly assure returning users that signing into their primary account will immediately retrieve their saved pets.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again, making account recovery copy crucial for user retention.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Access & Safeguard Your Saved Desktop Pets
sign_in.body: Log into your account to sync your existing pets, preserve customization details, and keep your virtual companions safe across sessions.

guard.reason: Valid copy update clarifying sign-in account sync without violating any base rules.

candidates.score_note: Sign-in copy changes consistently perform well (+3.1%) and address 8 support emails directly.

candidates.title: Compact Pet Character Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the pick_friend screen layout to compact view with prominent preview cards and trait badges.
candidates.why: Adoption redesigns previously improved conversion by +3.0% on average, and adoption drops off at 77.8% with an 89s median time.

guard.reason: 'pick_friend.replace.pet_choices[1]': a badge cannot do the pet_choices job (use ['animation', 'button', 'choice_cards', 'image', 'preview', 'text'])

candidates.title: Background Rendering System Wait Info
candidates.change: Adds real-time status updates and estimated wait time to the waiting screen while desktop graphics assets initialize.
candidates.why: Wait_info changes in home step previously boosted conversion by +2.9% average, helping users endure the median 201s waiting step.

waiting.body: Preparing your desktop environment and loading pet render shaders...

guard.reason: Valid real-time progress and wait time estimate addition to the waiting screen.

candidates.score_note: Home wait_info updates have strong historical performance (+2.9%) targeting a 201s median wait time.

candidates.title: Pet Collection Preview Screen
candidates.change: Adds a new pet collection showcase screen before path selection to highlight available pet companions and set expectations.
candidates.why: Choose_path screen suffers from 81.7% conversion with high mean time (514s), showing users need early context before picking a creation path.

new_pet_preview.headline: Meet Your Virtual Desktop Companions
new_pet_preview.body: Explore companion types before deciding whether to pick an instant pet or build a custom friend.

guard.reason: Valid addition of a new preview screen within onboarding while retaining all required steps.

candidates.score_note: Adding new screens historically underperforms or hurts conversion while incurring high implementation cost.

candidates.title: Pet Generation Diagnostic Flow
candidates.change: Adds a pet quality check flow during custom pet creation to validate uploaded photos and prevent generation glitches.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or corrupted pet appearances, causing drop-off during adoption.

new_generation_check.headline: Pet Appearance & Asset Diagnostic
new_generation_check.body: We are verifying photo contours and texture rendering to ensure your pet generates correctly.

guard.reason: Valid addition of a diagnostic step within onboarding without removing required screens.

candidates.score_note: Addresses drop-off and support tickets in adoption, but new flows consistently show negative impact (-1.8%).

candidates.title: Card Layout Photo Upload Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the upload_photos screen into a clean card layout with interactive photo upload components and visual guidelines.
candidates.why: Adoption redesigns have shown strong positive conversion gains (+3.0% avg), and custom pet generation errors remain a major support topic.

guard.reason: 'upload_photos.replace.photo_upload[0].asset' must be a bundled onboarding asset id (asset:...)

candidates.title: Desktop Asset Initialization Wait Info
candidates.change: Displays step-by-step loading status tips on the waiting screen to clarify desktop engine setup progress.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets mentioned pet not showing up on desktop or app failing to open, while home wait_info tests consistently show +2.9% conversion gains.

waiting.headline: Initializing Desktop Pet Workspace

guard.reason: Valid addition of step-by-step wait information on the waiting screen.

candidates.score_note: Supported by support tickets and funnel wait time; wait_info changes reliably deliver positive gains.

candidates.change: Adds clear messaging to sign_in body explaining that signing in restores existing pets and prevents duplicate desktop profiles.
candidates.why: Sign_in copy changes have a strong track record (+3.1% average win rate across 5 winning tests) and address 8 emails about lost pets.
